# Vulkan header provenance

`vulkan_core.h` and `vk_platform.h` are unmodified files from
[KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers tag v1.2.198](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.2.198/include/vulkan).
They retain the Khronos copyright and Apache-2.0 identifiers. The upstream
`LICENSE.txt` is included. The adapter uses Vulkan 1.0 compute APIs.
